courses.overview: 從域分解、訊息語意與數值平行驗證延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend domain decomposition, message semantics and numerical parallel validation to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 科學高效能計算排程
related.why: 都需正確任務繫結與環境版本
related.whyEn: Both need correct placement and environment versions
related.transfer: 都需正確任務繫結與環境版本
related.transferEn: Both need correct placement and environment versions
related.difference: MPI 的訊息正確性不是排程器的保證
related.differenceEn: Schedulers do not guarantee MPI message correctness

place.name: Oak Ridge 公開科學運算城市代表點
place.nameEn: Oak Ridge public scientific-computing city reference
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「科學高效能計算排程」共用的資料／元件介面；以「都需正確任務繫結與環境版本」指出能保留的條件。
針對「MPI 的訊息正確性不是排程器的保證」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with scientific hpc scheduling; use "Both need correct placement and environment versions" to identify retained conditions.
For "Schedulers do not guarantee MPI message correctness", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

courses.summary: 大型 MPI 平行模擬從域分解、訊息語意與數值平行驗證連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Large-scale MPI parallel simulation connects interfaces, data and acceptance through domain decomposition, message semantics and numerical parallel validation. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.

courses.connectionEn: Connect domain decomposition to result validation, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: MPI 定義通訊語意而非單一網路速度；課程從小格網驗證數值與訊息，再分析擴展性。
history.textEn: MPI defines communication semantics, not one network speed; small grids validate numerics and messages before scaling analysis.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
